The parts look like multiple engines/assemblies mixed together rather than one complete engine unit.
No clear vehicle make/model badge, engine code plate, or VIN is visible.
There is no photo of an intact engine block with identification markings.
The only readable text appears to be painted/printed numbers on the container side, but it does not clearly identify the engine model.

No ES350-specific engine code/label/part number visible in the photos.

risks.risk: The container may contain mixed parts from different engines/years, not a single confirmed engine family.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block (or cylinder head) showing stamped engine code/part number, plus a photo of any matching intake manifold/ECU label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unverified engine parts (worst case: incomplete and not guaranteed to assemble into one working engine).

risks.risk: Missing critical components (starter, alternator, crank sensor, timing components, oil pump, ECU, wiring harness, etc.) could prevent a rebuild.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip laid out by category (timing set, sensors, covers, crank/cam, intake/exhaust, accessories) or a checklist showing what is included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed complete for a working engine (worst case: parts-only, incomplete).

risks.risk: Condition unknown: parts may be worn, cracked, or previously damaged (e.g., bent valves, scored cylinder walls, broken housings).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of high-failure areas: cylinder bores (if accessible), cam/crank journals, timing chain guides, water pump area, and any visible cracks/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/unknown condition (worst case: needs overhaul; not assumed serviceable).

risks.risk: No confirmation of compatibility with the buyer’s target vehicle (RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry engines differ).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact engine code and/or the donor vehicle details (engine bay plate or VIN/registration) from the seller’s side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic Toyota/Lexus engine parts with uncertain fitment (worst case: may not match your engine).

proof_requests: Photo of the engine block/cylinder head showing the stamped engine code (and/or part number) clearly.
A photo showing the ECU/major sensors (or labels) if included, to confirm the exact engine variant.
A complete inventory list (or laid-out photos) showing which parts are included vs missing.
Close-ups of any cracked/broken components and of critical wear surfaces (cam/crank journals, timing components).
response.reason: The photos show mixed engine parts with no readable engine code or identification, so the seller’s claimed 2008–2015 RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry fitment cannot be verified remotely. Without the exact engine identification and completeness/condition proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
